error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Door Entry authentication (not necessarily wrong password). Check the Home Assistant log for BTicino auth failure reason_code.

error.unsupported_installation: No compatible gateway and door lock on that installation. Pick another from the list (no re-login).

abort.unsupported_installation: No compatible gateway and door lock were found
